summary: This note is an encyclopedia-style overview of the Los Angeles Lakers, an American professional basketball team based in Los Angeles. It explains that the Lakers play in the NBA's Western Conference Pacific Division and host games at Staples Center, which they share with three other Los Angeles teams. It also notes that the Lakers are among the NBA's most successful franchises, with 16 championships, second only to the Boston Celtics.
one_line: Overview of the Los Angeles Lakers, an NBA team in the Western Conference Pacific Division known for 16 championships.
key_facts: The Los Angeles Lakers are an American professional basketball team based in Los Angeles.
The Lakers compete in the National Basketball Association (NBA).
The Lakers are a member of the NBA's Western Conference in the Pacific Division.
The Lakers play their home games at Staples Center.
Staples Center is shared with the NBA's Los Angeles Clippers.
Staples Center is shared with the Los Angeles Sparks of the Women's National Basketball Association.
Staples Center is shared with the Los Angeles Kings of the National Hockey League.
The Lakers are described as one of the most successful teams in the history of the NBA.
The Lakers have won 16 NBA championships.
The Lakers' 16 NBA championships are the second-most in NBA history, behind the Boston Celtics.
